facts.business: The Company is engaged in the business of manufacturing and providing smart metering solutions and services to utilities (power, gas and water) globally, with a focus on India, and also delivers comprehensive solutions as an Advanced Metering Infrastructure Service Provider (AMISP).

capacity_or_capex.item: Capital expenditure towards research and development centre
Term loan for Assam unit project (Smart Electricity Energy Meters)
Term loan for Kotputli, Rajasthan unit (Moulding Plant for Electronic Energy Meter)

guidance_or_targets.statement: The Company believes new tender activity has moderated temporarily as utilities absorb earlier orders and expects activity to resume over the medium term.

auditor.name: Not explicitly stated in excerpts
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter: Search under Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 conducted by Directorate of Enforcement at Company's Corporate office and Chairman's residence; opinion not modified.

key_risks: Revenue recognition complexity and judgment in AMISP contracts with multiple performance obligations
Valuation and recoverability of receivables and contract assets due to procedural clearances from government utilities
Search under Prevention of Money Laundering Act, 2002 by Directorate of Enforcement
Temporary moderation in new tender activity as utilities absorb earlier orders
Dependence on government utility approvals and procedural clearances
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with Sections 177 and 188 of the Companies Act, 2013, except for a loan extended to a related party which was ratified by the audit committee subsequent to extension. Loans to related parties: Non-current Rs 254.39 crore, Current Rs 228.63 crore as on March 31, 2026.
